**Mandatory** section. It contains the traceability matrices that show the dependencies between the elements of the DAS and with the requirements of the ERS. MADEJA recommends at least these matrices:
- **External dependencies**: classes against requirements (mainly information requirements and business rules); sequence diagrams, screens and reports against requirements (mainly use cases and behavioral requirements); services interfaces against requirements (mainly integration requirements and technical constraints). - **Internal dependencies**: classes against sequence diagrams, and screens and reports against sequence diagrams and against classes.
Recommended archetypes: **Traceability matrix**.
